system.description:
Named Unique (short sword +1). Regeneration and magical healing do not restore the damage it deals until the end of the encounter.

Quirk (Weeping): red beads gather on the blade and never dry, staining every sheath it rests in. A torturer's blade of the Order of the Silver Lash, taken when the order was made defunct.

Monsters & Treasure, Named Uniques. Saves use DC 10 + half your level + the attribute named.
